_help: Amazon deals section: a flash-sale card (the amazon.eg page in "flash") and one "See the deals" button per category, on the Amazon Egypt page (full) and the home page (short), with the affiliate tag from amazon-picks.json. A button opens Amazon's search for that category (node = the number after node= or n: in an amazon.eg category link) with a loose discount filter: not every product it lists is discounted, so never write a percentage or promise a discount here. Each item: key (not flash), node, icon (phone, basket or one of the ad_ icons in tools/build.pl), name and note in en + ar. Edit it from the dashboard (إدارة المحتوى > عروض أمازون).
